name: Evidence Gathering & Authoring Provenance
description: Decompose research topic areas, shortlist required papers and datasets, retrieve authoritative metadata and open-access texts across scholarly databases (Crossref/DOI, arXiv, PubMed, InspireHEP, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, Google Scholar), ingest into declared KG subgraphs, assess relevancy and claim boundaries, and record authoring provenance notes and formal citations.
